correctness.rationale: Every depth-m column is a composition of m among r identities, one saturating successor and one reset. It is nonconstant iff there is no reset and at most d successors; this directly yields the binomial formula. Constant types first acquire the highest value at depth d+1. A two-sided fixed point uses all letters, so distinct formal maps really are distinct progressions. Primitivity, height one and aperiodicity are proved, and the discrepancy pair operator equals rI plus nilpotent successor, allowing the properly attributed 2026 Theorems A/B. Independent iterated-word diagnostics passed 1,822 integer assertions; they supplement, not replace, proof.
